projects.title: Assistive Indoor Navigation
projects.subtitle: Vision-language indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users
projects.summary: AI-powered indoor navigation using vision-language reasoning to support blind and low-vision users.
highlights: Combines scene understanding, floor-plan reasoning, and navigation guidance.
Designed around accessibility and practical indoor mobility workflows.

projects.title: WildfireVLM
projects.subtitle: Vision-language wildfire detection and risk assessment
projects.summary: Vision-language system for early wildfire detection and risk assessment from satellite imagery; accepted at IGARSS 2026.
highlights: Connects visual wildfire evidence with language-based risk interpretation.
Targets remote-sensing and environmental decision-support settings.

projects.title: Claude Code Encyclopedia
projects.subtitle: Searchable Claude Code, Codex and GitHub CLI reference
projects.summary: A searchable, offline-capable reference covering 504 commands, flags, settings keys, hooks, and configuration paths across Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI, plus a data-backed catalog whose GitHub CLI family documents the gh command line end to end.
highlights: 504 reference entries across 18 sections in the offline encyclopedia.
A JSON-backed catalog of 166 entries where adding a command is a data edit, not a code edit.
99 GitHub CLI entries across nine sections, validated against a schema in CI.
OS-aware examples, version awareness, keyboard navigation, and local favorites.

projects.title: Medical Image Segmentation
projects.subtitle: Multi-task medical image analysis
projects.summary: Multi-task deep-learning platform for automated medical image analysis with explicit handling of imbalanced datasets.
highlights: Focuses on segmentation and classification workflows.

projects.title: Vision-Language Medical AI
projects.subtitle: CLIP-based medical vision-language research
projects.summary: Custom CLIP-based architecture for medical imaging with zero-shot classification and report-generation capabilities.
highlights: Connects medical visual features with language representations.

projects.title: Knowledge Distillation
projects.subtitle: Hint-based model compression
projects.summary: Hint-based knowledge-distillation framework reported on the existing project page as achieving 2.5× model compression with minimal accuracy loss.
highlights: Focuses on efficient transfer from larger teacher models to smaller students.
Targets reduced deployment cost while retaining predictive quality.

projects.title: Graph Autoencoder
projects.subtitle: Residual GNN representation learning
projects.summary: Graph neural-network implementation using residual connections for representation learning on graph-structured data.
highlights: Uses graph autoencoding for representation learning.
Explores residual connections in graph neural networks.

projects.title: ML Data Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Scalable preprocessing and feature engineering
projects.summary: Scalable data-processing pipeline described on the existing project page as handling 10 TB+ daily with automated preprocessing and feature engineering.
highlights: Designed around high-volume machine-learning data workflows.
